verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is one community comment. It says Chargebee lets you configure VAT rates and choose whether invoices are tax-inclusive or tax-exclusive, and that filing and paying the VAT remains the merchant's job. That shows basic native tax calculation, but no first-party doc in the pack covers it. Missing for 10: first-party tax documentation, sales tax and GST support, a first-class tax integration (e.g., automated tax engine), handling of tax registrations and jurisdiction rate management, independent or hands-on corroboration.
